title: Wander through the New York Botanical Garden’s Orchid Show

location.label: New York Botanical Garden, New York

description: Step from a New York winter into the conservatory, where orchids appear among tropical plants in an annual themed exhibition. Take time to look at the small details as well as the large installations: color, shape, and scent vary from flower to flower. The show is seasonal, so check the current design and dates before planning around it.
teaser: Find a vivid indoor garden in the middle of winter.
goodToKnow: Check the current Orchid Show theme, dates, ticketing and conservatory access.
whyItMightDelightYou: The variety of orchids rewards slow looking and turns a cold day into a warm one.
